heading: Hardware brain,
paragraphs: I'm a Computer Engineering student based in Alaminos, Laguna, specializing in embedded systems and robotics. My thesis, AeroTech 737R — a Pixhawk and Raspberry Pi-based rescue drone — was accepted for presentation at Philippine Metals 2026 (IMEC 2026).

Alongside hardware, I build full-stack websites — from custom CMS builds to production deployments — through freelance work and internships. I like projects where I get to touch both the circuit board and the codebase.
